findings.motion: M11 Concur (House concurrence in the Senate committee substitute), Roll Call #801, passed 62-47; Cohn is listed among the No votes
findings.note: House vote on HB 958, Election Law Changes. The ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) requires an applicant to affirmatively state US citizenship before a registration is processed, adds a 30-day sworn-statement notice when the citizenship question is left blank, has the State Board create a process to remove voters flagged as non-citizens from a federal database, and also covers other election administration changes. The bill was vetoed 2026-08-17. The bill text does not change photo ID rules at the polls.
subjects: removal of non-citizens from voter rolls

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (roll call 758)
findings.note: HB 958 (Election Law Changes) is an omnibus election bill. The edition read here includes voter-list maintenance, removal of voters flagged as possible non-citizens, and absentee and ballot-challenge changes. The roll call transcript lists this member among the Noes.
